data.title: XRP ETFs Gain as Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds Lose $317 Million. Is It a Trend?
data.description: While Bitcoin and Ethereum funds hemorrhage hundreds of millions, XRP funds are quietly pulling in new money from investors already sitting on heavy losses. Whether that signals conviction or something else entirely depends on what happens next.
